This '''upscale [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]''' was owned by the [[Bergamasque]] [[Salla C'airam]] and located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]]. His establishment had features that were designed to relax his clientele, including soft, [[dirge]]-like music, and programmed light shows across the walls. Claiming to cater to a wide range of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] physiology, C'airam's menu boasted a number of [[Alcohol/Legends|intoxicants]], including exotic liqueurs. The kitchen was staffed by [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]], and could produce enough food for a large banquet, which C'airam usually reserved for distinguished guests. To prevent violent confrontations and destruction of the decor, C'airam housed a number of [[Diet/Legends|ergovores]] in the entrance and kept them underfed just enough so that they would detect the presence of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]]. The power packs would then be relinquished to the proprietor upon entry to the cantina.

[[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] visited this cantina while tracking [[Drawmas Sma'Da]], a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who was wanted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for his seemingly-impossible luck with odds and betting in his self-developed [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide gambling operation, the [[Invisible & Ineluctable Casino]]. When Sma'Da arrived, C'airam greeted him with a banquet that had been prepared prior. After a short while, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] made their move, with Zuckuss apprehending Sma'Da. He and 4-LOM then removed the gambler from the establishment. C'airam declared them both to be banned from his cantina, though Zuckuss claimed not to care, as "the drinks were terrible, anyway."
